Text.character.name: The Beheaded
Text.character.description:
A greedy, arrogant king, seeking new amusements and bloodshed in the Spire.
Accompanied by the enchanted sword Serenade.
Text.skin.white.selected: ✨ Proof of a flawless victory. The White King arrives!
Text.skin.blue.selected: 🔵 A familiar look. Back to the classics.

Idle: I hope you've got some food ready for me.
This island feels different somehow... Hm. Must be my imagination.
What happened to all that fighting you promised?
Thank goodness I can't smell anything.
Attack: Hey, hurry up and hit something!
That last monster had a bit of a kick...
Hit: Dodge, you idiot! Are you trying to snap me in half?!
Who said anyone but me could touch him?!
Why are WE getting hit?! Hit them back!
Stop blocking blades with that lump of meat you call a body!
Hey! They got me dirty! Kill them!
Summon: More food for me? Good boy!
Now that you've woken me up, kill a few more!
We're going killing together again? Wonderful!
I'm heavier now... Hold tight. Don't drop me!
More... I need more power to tear them apart!
That's more like it! Now take me to something I can slice!
Forge: This scrap of iron just got heavier!
Give me flesh to hone my edge!
Brimming with power... Hungry for the kill!
